The QRCode directory is the MIT-licensed QR encoder by Kazuhiko Arase (copyright 2009), adapted by qrcode-terminal and already distributed with the project's local npm. Original copyright headers are retained. QRCODE-LICENSE contains the qrcode-terminal distribution license (Apache-2.0).

Only the encoder is used, server-side, to render the Pix payload as a local SVG with a four-module quiet zone. No external QR image service receives customer or payment data.
